# hallpass_policy_rule (Resource)

An access rule. HallPass denies by default; rules allow agents (`subjects`) to see, request or be approved automatically for roles (`roles`) on servers and git remotes (`targets`), and `deny` rules override every allow. Import with the rule ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hallpass_policy_rule" "sre_inspect" {
  name     = "SRE inspect production"
  effect   = "allow"
  level    = "auto_approve"
  subjects = { agent_groups = ["sre-agents"] }
  targets  = { server_labels = { match_labels = { env = "prod" } } }
  roles    = { names = ["inspect"] }

  auto_max_duration = "30m"
  max_duration      = "2h"
  require_reason    = false
}

resource "hallpass_policy_rule" "sre_changes" {
  name     = "SRE changes on request"
  effect   = "allow"
  level    = "requestable"
  subjects = { agent_groups = ["sre-agents"] }
  targets  = { server_groups = ["prod-web"] }
  roles    = { names = ["deploy"] }
}

resource "hallpass_policy_rule" "no_bots_on_db" {
  name     = "Release bot never reaches databases"
  effect   = "deny"
  subjects = { agents = [hallpass_agent.claude_sre.id] }
  targets  = { server_labels = { match_labels = { tier = "db" } } }
  roles    = { all = true }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `effect` (String) `allow` or `deny`.
- `name` (String) Name.
- `roles` (Attributes) Which roles and access profiles. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles))
- `subjects` (Attributes) Which agents the rule applies to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subjects))
- `targets` (Attributes) Which servers and git remotes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--targets))

### Optional

- `auto_max_duration` (String) Longest access approved automatically (`auto_approve` only). A duration such as `30m` or `4h`.
- `description` (String) Description, shown to operators.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule applies.
- `level` (String) For `allow`: `visible` (listed only), `requestable` (a person approves) or `auto_approve` (approved automatically up to `auto_max_duration`). Not used with `deny`.
- `max_duration` (String) Longest access this rule allows (the role's maximum applies too). A duration such as `30m` or `4h`.
- `require_reason` (Boolean) Whether agents must give a reason.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Rule ID (`pol_…`).

Optional:

- `all` (Boolean) Match every role, including ones created later.

- `names` (Set of String) Role or access profile names (on any matching server).
- `role_labels` (Attributes) Roles by label. Every `match_labels` pair and every expression must hold. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles--role_labels))

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Rule ID
terraform import hallpass_policy_rule.sre_inspect pol_01m5qh1t09e4jbmeys0q0bjz8j
```
